你剛剛傳出的那條訊息——不管是 LINE、電子郵件，還是這篇文章正在從伺服器傳到你的螢幕——它很可能正在 4,000 公尺深的太平洋海底，以每秒 20 萬公里的速度，穿越一條比你的手腕還細的電纜。

你可能從來沒有意識到它的存在。但如果它斷了，你會立刻感受到。

現代世界的隱形脊梁

我們活在一個「無線」的時代——Wi-Fi、4G、5G，訊號彷彿在空氣中自由流動。但這個印象是個美麗的幻覺。事實上，超過 95% 的國際網路流量並非透過衛星傳輸，而是流經海底那些沉默的電纜。每一通跨國電話、每一筆跨境金融交易、每一個從海外伺服器載入的網頁，都在用海底電纜。

全球金融市場每天透過海底電纜進行的交易金額超過 10 兆美元。如果這些電纜突然中斷，不是某個地區會斷網而已——全球經濟都可能陷入混亂。

That message you just sent — whether it was a text, an email, or this article loading from a server — is most likely traveling right now, 4,000 meters beneath the Pacific Ocean, through a cable thinner than your wrist, moving at 200,000 km per second.

You've probably never thought about it. But the moment it breaks, you'll feel it immediately.

The Invisible Backbone of Modern Civilization

We live in a "wireless" age — Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G, signals seeming to flow freely through the air. But that impression is a beautiful illusion. In reality, more than 95% of international internet traffic doesn't travel via satellite — it flows through silent cables on the ocean floor. Every international call, every cross-border financial transaction, every webpage loading from an overseas server uses submarine cables.

Global financial markets process more than $10 trillion in daily transactions through submarine cables. If these cables were suddenly cut, it wouldn't just disconnect a region — the global economy could descend into chaos.

海底電纜是什麼？

海底電纜的外觀看起來就像一條粗纜繩——實際上，在淺水區直徑約 70 毫米，在深海中只有約 17 毫米。但它的內部卻是精密工程的結晶，層層結構各司其職：

①光纖芯最核心的光纖絲，以玻璃製成，直徑不到 0.1 毫米，傳遞光脈衝訊號
②凝膠填充層保護光纖、防止水份滲入
③鋼線盔甲多層鋼絲編織，在淺水區提供物理保護，抵擋船錨與漁網拖拉
④銅導體傳輸電力給沿途的訊號中繼器（repeater），每隔約 50 公里一個
⑤外層聚乙烯護套防水、防磨損的外保護層

這整條電纜由專用的海纜佈放船（cable ship）在海底慢慢鋪設，速度大約每小時 6 至 10 公里。鋪設一條連接兩大洲的電纜，往往需要數週乃至數月。

What Is a Submarine Cable?

A submarine cable looks like a thick rope — about 70mm in diameter in shallow water, just 17mm in the deep sea. But inside is precision engineering, with each layer serving a specific purpose:

①Optical fiber coreGlass fiber strands less than 0.1mm in diameter, carrying light-pulse data signals
②Gel fillingProtects fibers and prevents moisture intrusion
③Steel wire armorMulti-layer steel wire braiding for physical protection in shallow water against anchors and trawl nets
④Copper conductorDelivers electrical power to repeaters placed roughly every 50 km along the cable
⑤Polyethylene outer sheathWaterproof, abrasion-resistant outer protective layer

The entire cable is laid by specialized cable ships at about 6–10 km/h. Laying a cable connecting two continents can take weeks to months.

一條電纜如何傳遞資料？

電纜裡的光纖以「光脈衝」的形式傳遞資料。現代海底電纜的單條纖維，傳輸速度可達每秒數十 Tbps（兆位元）——相當於同時傳輸數百萬部 4K 電影。整條電纜可能包含數十對光纖，總容量達數百 Tbps。

由於光在光纖中傳輸時會逐漸衰減，每隔約 50–100 公里需要一個中繼器（Repeater）來放大訊號。這些中繼器依靠電纜中的銅導體供電，而電力來自兩端的陸地站。一條跨太平洋電纜可能有超過 300 個中繼器。

How Does a Cable Carry Data?

The fiber inside cables transmits data as light pulses. A single modern fiber strand can carry tens of Tbps — equivalent to simultaneously streaming millions of 4K movies. A cable may contain dozens of fiber pairs, with total capacity of hundreds of Tbps.

Because light attenuates as it travels through fiber, repeaters are needed every 50–100 km to amplify the signal. These repeaters are powered via the copper conductor in the cable, with electricity supplied from shore stations at each end. A transpacific cable may have over 300 repeaters.

歷史：從電報到光纖的 170 年

  • 1850英法之間的英吉利海峽鋪設了第一條海底電報電纜，傳遞摩斯電碼。全長僅 45 公里，次日即遭漁船錨損毀——這個問題今天依然存在。
  • 1858第一條跨大西洋電纜完工，連接英國與美國。美國總統與英國女王互發祝賀電報，惟電纜三週後失效。
  • 1866第一條可靠的跨大西洋電纜鋪設完成，正式開啟洲際即時通訊時代。
  • 1956TAT-1，第一條跨大西洋電話電纜通話，連接英美，可同時承載 36 路通話。
  • 1988TAT-8，第一條跨大西洋光纖電纜，速度是前代銅纜的 40,000 倍，開啟光纖海纜時代。
  • 2010s科技巨頭（Google、Facebook、Amazon、Microsoft）開始自行投資建設私有海底電纜，重塑全球網路架構。
  • 今日全球 400+ 條海底電纜，130 萬公里，承載全球 95%+ 的國際通訊。

History: 170 Years from Telegraph to Fiber Optics

  • 1850First submarine telegraph cable laid across the English Channel between England and France. Only 45 km long — damaged by a fishing anchor the next day. This problem still exists today.
  • 1858First transatlantic cable completed, connecting Britain and America. The US President and British Queen exchanged congratulatory telegrams; the cable failed three weeks later.
  • 1866First reliable transatlantic cable completed, inaugurating the era of intercontinental real-time communication.
  • 1956TAT-1, the first transatlantic telephone cable, connecting Britain and the US, supporting 36 simultaneous calls.
  • 1988TAT-8, the first transatlantic fiber optic cable, 40,000× faster than copper — launching the fiber optic submarine cable era.
  • 2010sTech giants (Google, Facebook, Amazon, Microsoft) begin investing in private submarine cables, reshaping global internet architecture.
  • Today400+ cables globally, 1.3 million km, carrying 95%+ of international communications.

台灣：島國的數位命脈

台灣作為島嶼，與外部世界的所有數位聯繫幾乎完全仰賴海底電纜。台灣目前擁有 14 條國際海底電纜及 10 條國內海纜（連接外離島）。這些電纜所承載的，不只是 Netlflix 串流或 LINE 訊息——更是台灣半導體出口訂單、金融市場資料、軍事通訊與政府指揮系統。

台灣的特殊脆弱性 台灣的國際海底電纜高度集中通過台灣海峽這個狹窄地帶。外離島的情況更加嚴峻：馬祖僅有 2 條電纜、金門僅有 1 條加上 1 條備援。如果這幾條電纜同時斷裂，外島將與台灣本島失去網路連線，只能依賴頻寬極為有限的微波通信。

2023 年 2 月，這個最壞的情況真實發生了。

但問題不只是斷網。海底電纜的維修極為耗時——2023 年馬祖斷纜事件，修復花了近 50 天。而且全球的海底電纜修復船數量極為有限，一旦多條電纜同時受損，修復隊列將無比漫長。

在戰略層面，海底電纜是台灣「數位韌性」最薄弱的環節。任何意圖孤立台灣、切斷其對外聯繫的行動，幾乎必然以海底電纜為目標。這正是本站監測的核心關切。

Taiwan: An Island Nation's Digital Lifeline

As an island nation, Taiwan's entire digital connection to the outside world depends almost entirely on submarine cables. Taiwan currently has 14 international submarine cables and 10 domestic cables (connecting outer islands). What they carry isn't just Netflix streams or messaging apps — but Taiwan's semiconductor export orders, financial market data, military communications, and government command systems.

Taiwan's Unique Vulnerability Taiwan's international submarine cables are heavily concentrated through the narrow Taiwan Strait corridor. The outer islands are even more precarious: Matsu has only 2 cables, Kinmen only 1 cable plus 1 backup. If these few cables are severed simultaneously, the outer islands lose internet connectivity with Taiwan proper, leaving only extremely limited-bandwidth microwave communications.

In February 2023, this worst-case scenario actually happened.

But the issue isn't just outages. Submarine cable repairs are extremely time-consuming — the 2023 Matsu cable incident took nearly 50 days to repair. Global cable repair ships are scarce, and if multiple cables are damaged simultaneously, the repair queue becomes very long indeed.

Strategically, submarine cables are the weakest link in Taiwan's "digital resilience." Any action aimed at isolating Taiwan and cutting off its external connections would almost inevitably target submarine cables. This is precisely the core concern that this monitoring site addresses.

為什麼這很重要？

海底電纜不是冷戰時代的遺物——它是 21 世紀最關鍵的基礎設施之一，卻長期缺乏應有的關注與保護。它的重要性體現在三個層次：

  • 經濟層面：全球貿易、金融市場、供應鏈管理都依賴它的穩定運作
  • 軍事層面：現代軍事行動的指揮、通訊、情報分享高度依賴民用海纜基礎設施
  • 政治層面：切斷電纜可以在不開戰的情況下，對特定地區施加巨大壓力

正因如此，海底電纜已成為「灰色地帶衝突」的理想目標：破壞效果顯著，但肇事者可以聲稱是「意外」，難以追責。下一篇文章將介紹 AIS 船舶追蹤系統，以及我們如何透過它發現可疑行為。

Why Does This Matter?

Submarine cables are not Cold War relics — they're among the most critical infrastructure of the 21st century, yet they have long received insufficient attention and protection. Their importance operates on three levels:

  • Economic: Global trade, financial markets, and supply chain management all depend on their stable operation
  • Military: Modern military command, communications, and intelligence sharing are deeply dependent on civilian cable infrastructure
  • Political: Cutting cables can impose enormous pressure on a specific region without firing a single shot

This is precisely why submarine cables have become ideal targets for "gray zone conflict": the damage is significant, but the perpetrator can claim "accident" and avoid accountability. The next article explains the AIS vessel tracking system and how we use it to detect suspicious behavior.

常見問題 FAQ

海底電纜真的承載了全球大部分網路流量嗎？
是的。超過 95% 的國際網路流量透過海底電纜傳輸，衛星僅佔極小比例。每一通跨國電話、跨境金融交易與海外網頁載入，幾乎都使用海底電纜。
海底電纜為什麼這麼細卻這麼重要？
深海段電纜直徑僅約 17 毫米，但單條光纖傳輸速度可達每秒數十 Tbps，整條電纜包含數十對光纖，總容量達數百 Tbps，相當於同時傳輸數百萬部 4K 電影。
一條海底電纜可以使用多久？
海底電纜的設計壽命通常約 25 年，但可能因海底地震、漁船拖網或船錨拖拉而提早受損，需要專用海纜維修船進行修復。
台灣有多少條海底電纜？
台灣本島擁有 14 條國際海底電纜及約 10 條國內海纜（連接外離島）。外離島極為脆弱，馬祖僅有 2 條電纜、金門僅 1 條加 1 條備援。

FAQ

Do submarine cables really carry most of the world's internet traffic?
Yes. Over 95% of international internet traffic travels through submarine cables, with satellites carrying only a tiny fraction. Nearly every international call, cross-border transaction, and overseas webpage load uses submarine cables.
Why are submarine cables so thin yet so important?
Deep-sea cable sections are only about 17mm in diameter, but a single fiber strand can carry tens of Tbps. A cable holds dozens of fiber pairs for hundreds of Tbps total — equivalent to streaming millions of 4K movies at once.
How long does a submarine cable last?
Submarine cables are typically designed for ~25 years, but can be damaged earlier by undersea earthquakes, fishing trawls, or ship anchors — requiring specialized cable repair ships to fix.
How many submarine cables does Taiwan have?
Taiwan's main island has 14 international submarine cables and about 10 domestic cables. The outer islands are highly vulnerable: Matsu has only 2 cables, Kinmen just 1 plus 1 backup.
